template_name: Generic planning project — starter work plan
description: A short, deliberately plain sequence that most planning projects share: agree the work plan, establish the baseline, produce a draft, take it out for review, and finish. It carries no assumptions about the kind of plan, the funding source, or the jurisdiction.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do; nothing here is a required scope.
Every date is calculated from the kickoff date you enter, using round day offsets. They are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
No jurisdiction is assumed. Nothing here reflects any state's or funder's procedural requirements; a project subject to those needs the milestones its own rules require.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and schedule
deliverables.summary: The agreed scope, task list, schedule and roles for the project, confirmed with the team after kickoff.

deliverables.title: Existing conditions summary
deliverables.summary: What is true today, and where each fact came from — the baseline every later recommendation is measured against.

deliverables.title: Draft plan document
deliverables.summary: The complete draft, assembled for internal review before it goes out publicly.

deliverables.title: Final plan document
deliverables.summary: The draft revised in response to review comments, with the comment record attached.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: The team, the scope and the schedule confirmed in one room.

milestones.title: Public review period opens
milestones.summary: The draft is released for comment. Set the closing date to whatever period your agency has committed to.

milestones.title: Adoption or acceptance decision
milestones.summary: The decision that ends the project — by whichever body has that authority here.
